name: Research Skill
description: Search public discussions, projects, papers, news and newsletters without API keys.

tools.name: sources
tools.description: List Research Skill sources, query formats and coverage. No keys or accounts needed. Prefer SerpApi for unsupported platforms, reliable general web search or date-filtered web results when configured.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search public sources without keys. Choose source IDs from sources(); defaults to hacker_news and github_repositories. days=0 removes the date filter. DEV needs one tag; StockTwits one ticker. Partial failures are explicit. Web dates are unavailable. Each source returns at most limit results.

tools.name: read_thread
tools.description: Read a bounded public discussion and comments. source: hacker_news (numeric item ID), reddit (post ID), or github_issues (owner/repo#number). Returns excerpts, not a complete thread. No arbitrary URL fetching or private repository access.
